description: Subprocess with argument list and no shell — safe execution

import subprocess

def run_lint(filepath):
    result = subprocess.run(
        ['flake8', '--max-line-length', '120', filepath],
        capture_output=True, text=True
    )
    return result.stdout

description: yaml.safe_load used instead of yaml.load — safe deserialization
why_safe: safe_load restricts to simple Python types, no code execution
code:
import yaml

def load_config(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        config = yaml.safe_load(f)
    return config
